title: Schema-less runtime recovery control plane, environment-scoped Breakglass catalog, and Work Map binding maintenance

phases.objective: Provide bounded schema-less recovery evidence and an environment-scoped Breakglass catalog for Staging local Windows/Docker and Production Hostinger runtimes, while retaining SQL/runtime recovery as separate reviewed authority paths.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: github_snapshot and repository_snapshot expose bounded read-only evidence without opening a database connection, fabricating a durable session, claiming runtime authority, or dispatching mutating tools.
steps: Load a repository snapshot or bounded GitHub snapshot descriptor under the runtime-recovery snapshot contract.
Reject sensitive fields, durable session identifiers, runtime-authority claims, mutation flags, and write-like tool descriptors.
Expose only canonical read-only recovery routes and the approved read-only runtime status descriptor.
Return explicit database_required=false, persistence=unavailable, and runtime_authority=false evidence.
Keep the SQL/runtime-mediated path separate and fail closed when its schema or table prerequisites are unavailable.
Require one shared Production mutation lock so primary and fallback cannot execute concurrently.
Separate canonical baseline bootstrap sources from incident recovery migrations and reject verification-only migrations from fallback apply.
Bind bearer readback destinations to the exact canonical Production origin and repeat centralized policy preflight inside the operator.
Run the route regression without connecting to or mutating a live database.
assertions: Breakglass environment selection is explicit: Staging is local Windows/Docker on main, while Production is Hostinger Auto Deploy on Production through the fixed workflow dispatched from main.
Staging Breakglass never dispatches the Production workflow and never permits Admin-route migration or grant mutation; local operator authority remains separate.

Production Breakglass never accepts caller-supplied database names, credentials, arbitrary refs, workflow paths, or target keys; repository-owned GitHub variables resolve the target inside the reviewed workflow.
Full database rebuild is plan/dry-run only and non-empty destructive replacement is not routable through this catalog.
Snapshot source values are non-secret and bounded; snapshot JSON is never read from GitHub Secrets.
Snapshot strategy rejects sql source mode and any apply_execution request.
Snapshot session context has no durable session_id and no persistence write path.
Snapshot tool dispatch blocks unapproved or mutating tools with a bounded read-only error.
Hostinger Auto Deploy provenance uses canonical route_key values and structured full SHA/branch evidence rather than arbitrary provider deployment credentials.
Primary and fallback concurrency is keyed to the shared Production mutation lock.
Fallback target configuration has no ambiguous migrations field; baseline and incident entries are independently allowlisted, checksum-bound, and role-bound.

Canonical governed_migration_ledger readback fails closed on any checksum conflict; already-applied states are skipped, while schema-ready without apply-ledger evidence requires the explicitly authorized idempotent 20260815 apply flow and is not reconciled as record-only.
Production bearer requests cannot target a non-canonical hostname, port, userinfo, path prefix, query, or fragment.
The operator invokes centralized recovery policy before strategy execution, including when run directly outside the workflow.
No Migration Apply, grant, database/provider mutation, deployment, restart, Policy Apply, Production activation, force push, or secret evidence occurs during validation.
